name: What type of drywall texture is hardest to match on a repair?

mainEntity.name: What type of drywall texture is hardest to match on a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best texture match is the one that blends under normal room lighting, not just from a distance. Knockdown, orange peel, smooth finish, and custom hand-applied textures each require different tools and skill, and ceiling repairs are usually harder to hide than wall repairs. If you have a strong existing pattern, ask whether the contractor has experience matching that exact texture before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smooth and simple textures are easier to match; custom hand-applied textures and ceiling patterns are usually the hardest.
